reference_selection: Independent development Oracle grids, separate candidate1024 and full4097 populations. All three development starts required; fixed before selection readouts.
uncertainty: Paired crossed start/premise-group bootstrap, conditional on frozen candidate choices; three starts, descriptive intervals and no automatic noninferiority claim.
recipe_choice: No final outcome may select a method, LR, stopping point, behavior model or success threshold.
notes: Primary matched long-horizon arms and development-selected short/tuned arms are reported separately.
The chosen candidate is evaluated under the same population-specific Oracle reference for every selector.
Direct fullpool accuracy uses one4097-example pool per start. Candidate direct accuracy averages the five fixed candidates within each start.
Initial-agent/no-change choice ties all candidates and uses lexicographic order; it is not evaluated as a learned surrogate.
Positive acceleration requires actual time/quality evidence against shorter and independently tuned no-predictor controls, not just lower true-gradient counts.

Candidate0 was also used for development recipe selection; random candidates overlap the original update pool. Genre candidates are the separate group-disjoint training-data transfer condition. All final selection/readout groups remain independent.
method_label_note: Fullpool Oracle32 LR.001/256 already exists in blind_matched_jobs under method label oracle32_matched; candidate tuned reference retains oracle32_lr0.0003.

direct_paired_controls.purpose: Original CV16 at the same horizon and LR

direct_paired_controls_registration.scope: Paired uncertainty for already declared matched/cheap controls, plus the stronger-quality graph Oracle. Native Oracle remains the primary practical reference; no predictor choice is changed.

random_family_train_all_control_registra.scope: Practical no-selection alternative using the already available original4097-example pool. More training examples than a1024-example candidate, explicitly not a fixed-data-size comparison. Uses existing frozen fullpool adapters; no extra recipe search. This control does not cover the union of the five new genre datasets.
